note: Maps Venture Evidence Explorer (VEE) backtest features to labels of this project's criteria. Only exact equivalences are used by default. An approximate entry is a lower bound in VEE's vocabulary (for example prototype = yes means at least a prototype) and is used only with --include-approximate. A VEE value with no entry is left unrated: missing, never zero.

cohort.label: New Zealand
cohort.rationale: Every case is in VEE's New Zealand first institutional seed cohort; the cohort rule requires the company to be founded or headquartered in New Zealand, as reported by the entry source.

features.label: Fintech and B2B software
features.rationale: VEE's enterprise software grouping is B2B software.

features.label: Consumer and marketplaces
features.rationale: Consumer retail and e-commerce sit in the consumer grouping.

features.label: Prototype
features.rationale: VEE records only that a prototype existed; the company may have been pilot-ready or commercial.

features.label: Paid pilot
features.rationale: VEE records a paid pilot or revenue; production customers are not distinguished.

unmapped.product_type: VEE product types have no criterion in this project.
unmapped.market_focus: International focus is not the same as an offshore route to market.
unmapped.business_model: No criterion records the business model.
unmapped.round_size_band: No criterion records the round size.
